I am reviewing the Monopoly game state to make a decision.

I hold three properties and $846 cash. p2 has utilities and two reds. p3 owns Tennessee and Illinois. p4 holds New York Avenue.

Virginia is still unowned. I cannot trade for it. p2 controls two of three reds and needs Illinois from p3. p4 holds New York Avenue.

I am deciding between trading, mortgaging, or ending my turn. I cannot build anything yet. My main goal is completing the pink monopoly by acquiring Virginia Avenue. p3 has repeatedly rejected offers to trade Illinois for cash over $850.

I am weighing whether to trade B&O Railroad. p2 has one railroad, and a second would double their rent. I bought B&O specifically to block them, so giving it away cheaply is risky. I also need to preserve cash for Virginia Avenue and any houses.

I am now considering a trade for Illinois Avenue. p3 demands $850 to $900, which would deplete my cash reserves. I could offer B&O Railroad plus cash instead. This would block p2 from completing the red monopoly and give p3 a second railroad.
